claims.text: To The Stars Academy 'partnered with research labs founded by Puthoff' to study the ADAM Research Project materials.

TTSA's SEC filing covering the period to June 2018 showed a $37.4 million accumulated deficit and $129,000 cash, with auditors flagging doubt about the company's ability to continue as a going concern.
